# The Estate Organiser (Australian Edition)

> The Estate Organiser is a fill-in-the-blanks workbook for Australian families. You write down where everything is kept: bank accounts, super funds, insurance policies, where the passwords live, funeral wishes, final instructions. Then the person who has to sort it all out one day is not left guessing. It is not an app and it is not a cloud service. The printed edition is a coil bound book you fill in by hand. The digital edition is a fillable file that stays on your own computer. What you write is never stored on our servers. The Organiser is a record-keeping tool. It is not legal, financial or tax advice, and it does not replace a Will or the work a solicitor does. It sits alongside those documents. Operated by Prestige Worldwright Pty Ltd (ABN 46 691 517 692). Canadian and American editions are published separately.

- [The Estate Organiser](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/): what the book is, what sits inside it, and why a Will on its own leaves gaps.
- [Pick where you're starting](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/start-here/): one page that points you to the right product depending on whether you are organising your own affairs or handling someone else's.
- [The 2-Minute Estate Readiness Check](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/estate-quiz/): a free two-minute quiz on how ready your family would be if something happened tomorrow.

- [The Estate Organiser product page](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/the-estate-organiser/): the full workbook. Digital Edition $79 AUD, Printed Edition $139 AUD, Printed + Digital $149 AUD. One-time payment, free shipping in Australia.
- [The Legacy Edition](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/the-estate-organiser/): everything in one order, $199 AUD. The printed book, the digital edition, the Guided Course, the Executor's Companion and the Conversation Kit.
- [The Estate Organiser Course](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/the-estate-organiser-au-course/): $197 AUD, 33 short video lessons across 10 modules that walk you through the workbook until it is finished. The full organiser is included.

## Free

- [The Free Executor Toolkit](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/toolkit/): a free PDF guide for whoever handles an estate, covering the first 48 hours, the first-year timeline, common missteps, plus an expense log and notification templates.
- [A Conversation Starter](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/a-conversation-starter/): one complete conversation guide, free, nothing to sign up for. The talk about where the Will is and who will handle things one day.

## Companion products

- [The Estate Conversation Kit](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/the-estate-conversation-kit/): $27 AUD. Word-for-word opening lines for the seven family conversations that usually come before the paperwork makes sense.
- [The Executor's Companion](https://www.theestateorganiser.com.au/executors-companion/): $39 AUD. A fillable working file for someone administering an estate right now, so every call, payment and letter is logged in one place.
